skim.title: Then and Now — The Sea Is Changing
skim.subtitle: Read quickly and find the main idea!
sentences: Guess what? The sea near Greenfield has changed a lot in the last ten years.
Ten years ago, there were a lot of dolphins near the coast. Children could see them from the beach.
There were many seals on the rocks too. They loved diving and splashing in the clean water.
There was not much plastic in the sea then. The water was clear and blue.
But today, there is a lot of plastic in the water. There are many fishing nets near the shore too.
There are no seals on the rocks now. They moved to cleaner waters far away. What a shame!
There are not many dolphins near the coast anymore. Pollution scared them away.
There was a lot of fish in the sea ten years ago. Now there is not much fish left.
Ms. Reed says: "That's a good point — we must act now before it is too late!"
Nora says: "I think things will get better if we work together. Don't worry — we can do this!"
translations: Biliyor musunuz? Greenfield yakınlarındaki deniz son on yılda çok değişti.
On yıl önce kıyıda çok sayıda yunus vardı. Çocuklar onları sahilden görebiliyordu.
Kayalıklarda da pek çok fok vardı. Temiz suda dalış yapmayı ve sıçramayı seviyorlardı.
O zamanlar denizde çok fazla plastik yoktu. Su berrak ve maviydi.
Ama bugün suda çok fazla plastik var. Kıyı yakınında da çok sayıda balıkçı ağı var.
Artık kayalıklarda fok yok. Uzaktaki daha temiz sulara taşındılar. Ne yazık!
Kıyıda artık pek fazla yunus yok. Kirlilik onları korkutup uzaklaştırdı.
On yıl önce denizde çok fazla balık vardı. Şimdi pek az balık kaldı.
Ms. Reed diyor: "Bu iyi bir nokta — çok geç olmadan harekete geçmeliyiz!"
Nora diyor: "Birlikte çalışırsak işlerin daha iyi olacağını düşünüyorum. Merak etmeyin — bunu başarabiliriz!"

skim.title: How Can We Help?

sentences: Ms. Reed asked: "What should we do to protect marine animals? Let's think together!"
Nora said: "We should stop using so much plastic. We shouldn't buy things with too much plastic packaging."
"We should take our rubbish home from the beach. We mustn't leave any waste near the water."
Sam said: "We should join beach clean-up days. That's interesting — even children can make a difference!"
"We shouldn't throw anything into rivers or lakes. Waste reaches the ocean very quickly."
Leyla said: "We should learn more about marine animals and their habitats. Knowledge is the best protection!"
"We mustn't buy things made from sharks or sea turtles. Hunting must stop."
Ms. Reed said: "That's a good point, Leyla. We should also support organisations that protect the ocean."
"We shouldn't ignore climate change either. A warmer ocean is the worst thing for marine life."

sentences: There is a special house in this riddle.
It is not a beach house. It is not a lake house.
It is not on land.
It is on the water!
It can move slowly with the water.
People sleep, eat and play in this house.
What kind of house is it?
It is a houseboat!
translations: Bu bilmecede özel bir ev var.
Plaj evi değil. Göl evi değil.
Karada değil.
Su üstünde!
Suyla yavaşça hareket edebilir.
İnsanlar bu evde uyur, yer ve oynar.
Bu ne tür bir ev?
Bir houseboat!

questions.q: Is it a beach house?
Is it on land?
Where is it?
What can it do?
What kind of house is it?

inf.title: What Are They Doing?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the activity!
sentences: Some marine animals are doing something special right now.
They are not swimming.
They are not hiding.
They are not crawling.
They jump up and splash with their tails.
They play in the waves with their friends.
What are these animals doing?
They are jumping and splashing!
translations: Bazı deniz hayvanları şu an özel bir şey yapıyor.
Yüzmüyorlar.
Saklanmıyorlar.
Yürümüyorlar.
Yukarı atlar ve kuyruklarıyla sıçrarlar.
Arkadaşlarıyla dalgalarda oynarlar.
Bu hayvanlar ne yapıyor?
Atlıyorlar ve sıçrıyorlar!

questions.q: Are they swimming?
Are they crawling?
What do they jump with?
Where do they play?
What are they doing?

inf.title: Which Advice Is Right?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the advice!
sentences: Ms. Reed has an important advice for us.
It is not about going to school.
It is not about doing homework.
It is about saving marine animals.
We should not throw something into the sea.
It is a small thing but it hurts sea turtles a lot.
What is Ms. Reed's advice?
We shouldn't throw plastic into the sea!
translations: Ms. Reed bize önemli bir tavsiye veriyor.
Okula gitmekle ilgili değil.
Ödev yapmakla ilgili değil.
Deniz hayvanlarını korumakla ilgili.
Denize bir şey atmamalıyız.
Küçük bir şey ama deniz kaplumbağalarına çok zarar verir.
Ms. Reed'in tavsiyesi nedir?
Denize plastik atmamalıyız!

questions.q: Is the advice about school?
What is the advice about?
What should we not do?
Who does it hurt?

inf.title: What Will the Weather Be Like?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to predict!
sentences: Look at the sky outside today.
It is not sunny.
It is not clear.
It is not snowy.
There are dark grey clouds everywhere.
The wind is strong.
What will the weather be tomorrow?
It will rain!
translations: Bugün dışarıdaki gökyüzüne bak.
Güneşli değil.
Açık değil.
Karlı değil.
Her yerde koyu gri bulutlar var.
Rüzgar güçlü.
Yarın hava nasıl olacak?
Yağmur yağacak!

questions.q: Is it sunny today?
How are the clouds?
How is the wind?
What will the weather be?
Is it clear today?

inf.title: Which Animal Is the Best?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the animal!
sentences: There is a special marine animal in this riddle.
It is the best swimmer in the ocean.
It is not the biggest animal in the sea.
It is not the worst hunter.
It is not the smallest animal.
It loves to jump out of the water.
It is a friend to sailors and children.
Which animal is it?
It is the dolphin!
translations: Bu bilmecede özel bir deniz hayvanı var.
Okyanustaki en iyi yüzücüdür.
Denizdeki en büyük hayvan değildir.
En kötü avcı değildir.
En küçük hayvan değildir.
Sudan dışarı atlamayı çok sever.
Denizcilere ve çocuklara arkadaştır.
Bu hangi hayvan?
Yunus!
